title: Parallel RUN --mount of a file fail with `ETXTBSY` when file is executing
body:
### Issue Description

Buildah fails when build stages running in parallel bind-mount the same file while one of the stage is executing it.

As far as I can tell, `bindFromChroot()`, buildah opens regular wiles with `O_RDWR` when bind mounting the files, despite not needing them for writing, as all writes, if the bind is writable, would go to an overlay?

This original breakage was introduced by the [cve-2024-11218](https://access.redhat.com/security/cve/cve-2024-11218) patch series, with https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/commit/50210d51#diff-da92e360ef93a185175588acbdc1faf280cc2f85d078254c096c04d9a505535cR21-R25 adding the O_RDWR flag, and https://github.com/podman-container-tools/buildah/commit/6e62bd leveraging it

### Steps to reproduce the issue

Steps to reproduce the issue

Given the following Containerfile:

```Dockerfile
FROM busybox AS holder
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=busybox,source=/bin/busybox,target=/tmp/busybox \
  /tmp/busybox sleep 3

FROM busybox AS contender
RUN sleep 1
RUN --mount=type=bind,from=busybox,source=/bin/busybox,target=/tmp/busybox \
  true
```

Build both stages concurrently:

```shell
# Use --skip-unused-stages to simplify the test Dockerfile, this can be also found in real use-cases
buildah build --no-cache --jobs=2 --skip-unused-stages=false .
```

Running it with `podman build` would fail the same way.


### Describe the results you received

Describe the results you received

The build fails with something like:

```
# Error: building at STEP "RUN --mount=type=bind,from=busybox,source=/bin/busybox,target=/tmp/busybox true": resolving mountpoints for container "61bcacd8ca3e0745a7364561f652b312f4705e38d6daf41584eaa9c532a06cbd": sanitizing bind subdirectory "/tmp/buildah_tests.ka9lri/root/vfs/dir/4a1d8130a46f8667019a82235c6603b7a2c62ebbd415911f27fe2d2fa1be6522/bin/busybox": opening non-directory "bin/busybox" under "/tmp/buildah_tests.ka9lri/root/vfs/dir/4a1d8130a46f8667019a82235c6603b7a2c62ebbd415911f27fe2d2fa1be6522": text file busy: text file busy
```


### Describe the results you expected

Describe the results you expected

The build succeeds,
Both stages should be able to bind-mount the file.


### Upstream Latest Release

Yes

### Additional environment details

Reproduces against both latest version and main branch

### Additional information

This is a race condition so might not happen 100% of the time
